title: Wall Mount Robe Hook Solid Brass 2.64-Inch Projection | Pink | Malibu Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add a dedicated place to hang robes and towels with this wall mount robe hook, crafted from brass and made to coordinate with the Malibu collection in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Brass construction for a sturdy everyday hook
  • Color-coordinated mounting hardware included
  • Assembled in the USA

Specs

  • Category: Robe Hooks
  • Collection: Malibu
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Overall size: 2 in L x 2 in H x 2.64 in W
  • Projection: 2.64 in
  • Weight capacity: 2 lb
  • Product weight: 0.5 lb
  • Screw size: 6
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Available in multiple designer finish options to help match other versatile bath accessories in the Malibu collection.
